[P2] Avoid repeatedly cloning large payloads

This accessor clones the complete byte array on every call. Serialization invokes it for hashing and again for writing after the constructor already cloned the codec output; deserialization similarly clones the bytes read from disk and again for verification. Payloads large enough to require offloading can therefore exhaust memory before reaching the filesystem. Keep one privately owned buffer for internal hashing/writing, or stream those operations without full-size copies.
